title: Naked Man Does This To a Female Cop
description:
It was the night of April 6th, 2024, when a man was roaming around Gilmer Way. He began banging on the door of one of the houses, and when the homeowner didn’t open it, he removed his clothes and ripped the light fixture off the front porch. He even threw a rock, breaking the window, and began chewing the broken glass. Soon after, an officer arrived on the scene. Upon seeing the officer, the man knelt down, but as the officer attempted to detain him, the man started fighting. More officers arrived on the scene to assist with the arrest, as the man refused to calm down and continued to resist. They decided to put him in restraints because he seemed to be out of his mind, and it was dangerous to leave him unrestrained. He grabbed the female officer's fingers, and she had to hit him multiple times, injuring her hand. Officers found a house with its door open. Initially, they thought the suspect had broken into it, but they found an ID that matched his face.He was taken to the hospital because the officers suspected he was intoxicated. The man continued to talk nonsense and behave in an agitated manner. After the checkup was completed, he was taken to the police department. He was charged with criminal damage to property, indecent exposure, battery on a peace officer and resisting arrest.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
